versions.subject: HTTP Request Smuggling (#3731)
versions.detection: `suricata` http.request_headers{}.name="*" | rename dest_ip as dest | spath path=http.request_headers{}.name output=header_names | mvexpand header_names | where lower(header_names) != "set-cookie" | stats count by _raw, header_names, src_ip, dest | where count > 1 | stats values(header_names) as duplicate_headers by _raw, count, src_ip, dest | `http_duplicated_header_filter`
versions.spl: sourcetype=suricata http.request_headers{}.name="*" | rename dest_ip as dest | spath path=http.request_headers{}.name output=header_names | mvexpand header_names | where lower(header_names) != "set-cookie" | stats count by _raw, header_names, src_ip, dest | where count > 1 | stats values(header_names) as duplicate_headers by _raw, count, src_ip, dest | MACRO=http_duplicated_header_filter
